line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Isolated copies compiled with same x86 product chartran.obj MSVC flags; current=0, remove-header=2, original-lookup=2 (C2039 Win32ClientInfo). No production edit, runtime test or publication.

decision: R2667: removing the include drops the allocation/free declarations and large string ABI. R2668: original GetClientInfo()->CodePage dereferences the NT4 native USER TEB layout. Actual product TEB view has no Win32ClientInfo; the provider uses current keyboard layout/locale and preserves last error. Forcing an include elsewhere or manufacturing a CLIENTINFO projection adds dependency without restoring original ownership.
